column1: # The world-model row, run as its OWN fleet because it does not fit beside a
# shared-card renderer: SimWAM needs 13.7 GiB of its own (measured 2026-09-06 on
# an idle 3090), and renderer + IsaacSim + SimWAM overruns 24 GiB. These workers
# therefore take two cards, which puts the renderer alone on GPU 0 at
# --cache-size 4 and SimWAM plus IsaacSim on GPU 1 at about 18.7 GiB.
# It emits a single trajectory, so plan_records.json carries a null candidate
# field rather than an absent one.
# The two env vars are paths the adapter would otherwise take from constants
# pointing at /bigdata, which this cluster does not mount: the repo, and the
# Wan2.2 VAE + umT5 base weights DiffSynth loads.
